{{Infobox location |name = Graveyard |mapx = 235 |mapy = 130 |building = Graveyard.png |openhours = Always |closed = Never |address = |occupants = |width = 300px }} The '''Graveyard''' is located just to the west of the [[Mayor's Manor]]. There are 4 gravestones located within its gates, 3 of which have further information if clicked on. ==Gravestones== There are 4 gravestones within the roughly 300 square tiles that are the Graveyard. ===Mona=== [[File:Monas Grave.png]] [[File:Grave.jpg]] The only gravestone with a name attributed to it, it sits in the middle of the top 3 stones. The epitaph reads: {{Quote|Our Beloved Mona}} [[Abigail]] can be seen sitting next to Mona's gravestone during her 6-heart event. She also stands in front of it, depending on her schedule. ===Old and Faded=== [[File:Old and Faded Gravestone.png]] The gravestone to the left of Mona's reads: {{Quote|It's old and faded...}} ===Dwarvish Headstone=== [[File:Dwarvish Gravestone.png]] After obtaining the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]], the gravestone to the right of Mona's reads: {{Quote|You translate the dwarvish:

Stand between the pillars three

With gift as precious as the sky:

A rainbow forged from land, not sea

Then galaxies will heed your cry.}} This is referring to the three pillars in the northeast of [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]]. ===Unknown=== [[File:Unknown Gravestone.png]] The stone that is the bottom left of the four is currently unclickable. {{NavboxLocations}} [[Category:Town Locations]] [[de:Friedhof]] [[es:Cementerio]] [[fr:Cimetière]] [[it:Cimitero]] [[ja:墓場]] [[ko:공동묘지]] [[hu:Temető]] [[pt:Cemitério]] [[ru:Кладбище]] [[tr:Mezarlık]] [[zh:墓园]]
